ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This blended format course includes face to face sessions to be held at the Oak Brook Multi-University Center, and online sessions using the Elluminate course delivery system (www.elluminate.com). Students are required to have a high speed internet connection, working microphone and speakers. Oak Brook site-based sessions will be held on: 1/21, 2/4, 2/11, 2/18, 3/18, 4/1, 4/21, and 5/6. Online sessions will be held on: 2/25, 3/4, 3/11, 4/8, 4/15, 4/22. Class will not meet on January 28 and March 25. This section is for M.S. students in NRES, AGED and graduate and undergraduate non-degree seeking students.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC, MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC, MS:Nat Res & Envrn Sci -UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $298.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $270.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $41.00 per Bill Hour.
